title: Returns & refunds
question: What is your return policy?
content: Northline accepts returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused and in their original packaging. Contact the support team to request a return authorization before shipping an item back. Original delivery fees are non-refundable. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days after inspection.

title: Support hours
question: Do you provide support on weekends?
content: The Northline support team is available Monday–Friday, 9:00–18:00 UTC. Human support is closed on weekends and public holidays. Messages received outside these hours are reviewed on the next business day. The self-service knowledge base is available at any time.

title: Delivery times
question: How long does delivery take?
content: Orders are prepared within 1–2 business days after payment. Standard delivery takes a further 3–5 business days after dispatch. These are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. Delivery may take longer during holidays. Northline does not currently offer express delivery.

title: Order cancellation
question: Can I cancel an order after payment?
content: You can request cancellation after payment if the order has not been dispatched. Contact support with the order number as soon as possible. A human agent must confirm the cancellation; this assistant cannot cancel orders. Once dispatched, the order must follow the returns process.

title: Product warranty
question: Do products come with a warranty?
content: Northline products include a 12-month limited warranty against manufacturing defects, starting on the delivery date. Accidental damage and normal wear are not covered. Contact support with proof of purchase and photos of the issue. A human agent reviews each warranty claim.

title: Damaged or missing items
question: What if an item arrives damaged?
content: If an item arrives damaged or is missing from the package, contact support within 7 days of delivery. Include the order number and photos of the packaging and affected item, if applicable. Keep the packaging while the support team reviews the issue. A replacement or refund requires human review.

title: Order tracking
question: How do I track an order?
content: When an order is dispatched, Northline sends a confirmation email with a tracking link. Carrier updates can take up to 24 hours to appear. If you cannot find the email, check your spam folder or contact support with the order number. This assistant has no access to live orders or carrier tracking.

title: Delivery locations
question: Which countries do you deliver to?
content: Northline currently delivers to Germany, France and the Netherlands. Delivery to other countries is not available in this fictional demo policy. We cannot confirm exceptions or custom shipping arrangements through this assistant.

title: Payment methods
question: Which payment methods are accepted?
content: Northline accepts Visa, Mastercard and PayPal at checkout. Payment is collected when the order is placed. Installment payments and payment by invoice are not currently offered. Never share card numbers, passwords or banking details in this demo chat.

title: Business & bulk orders
question: Can I request a quote for a bulk order?
content: For orders of 20 or more items, the Northline sales team can review a bulk-order request. Include the company name, products, quantities and preferred timeline. Pricing, discounts and availability require a human quote; this assistant cannot promise an offer.
